subject: Cannot read in methylation call file

messages.author: ab74ce81f1675322
messages.subject: Cannot read in methylation call file
parts:
I am using methylKit_0.9.6 and get error messages when I try to read in a methylation call file; specifically: Error in data.frame(chr = data[, 2], start = data[, 3], end = data[, 3],  : 
  arguments imply differing number of rows: 3245305, 9109922

Here is a relevant snippet from my Rstudio session in which I check the format and dimensions of a single file before trying to read it using methRead():

> my_data = read.table("A1_CpG_meth.mkc.txt", sep="\t", header=TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
> head(my_data)
     chrBase  chr  base strand coverage     freqC    freqT
1 chr1.10497 chr1 10497      F       49  91.83673 8.163265
2 chr1.10525 chr1 10525      F       49 100.00000 0.000000
3 chr1.10526 chr1 10526      R       46  93.47826 6.521739

5 chr1.10543 chr1 10543      R       88  97.72727 2.272727
6 chr1.10563 chr1 10563      F       51  90.19608 9.803922
> dim(my_data)
[1] 9109922       7
> file.list = list("A1_CpG_meth.mkc.txt")
> myobj=methRead(file.list,
+                sample.id=list("A1"),
+                assembly="hg19",
+                treatment=c(1), 
+                context="CpG")
Read 9109922 rows and 7 (of 7) columns from 0.399 GB file in 00:00:09
Error in data.frame(chr = data[, 2], start = data[, 3], end = data[, 3],  : 
  arguments imply differing number of rows: 3245305, 9109922


What could be causing this error? How can I fix it?

I still get the error with a shortened version of the file containing only the first 50 lines (which I've copied to the bottom of this post)

> myobj=methRead("Example.txt",
+                sample.id="A1",

parts:
This is a bug fixed in development version, it appeared after introducing the minimum coverage argument in  methRead(), if you install the development version (v0.99.2), it should be fixed there.

Best,
Altuna
